field.label: Allow Inbound Filters
field.help: Any names that do not match one of the filters in the list will be discarded from incoming packets on all interfaces.

field.label: Deny Inbound Filters
field.help: Any names that match one of the filters in the list will be discarded from incoming packets on all interfaces.

field.label: Disable Packet Filtering
field.help: Completely disables packet decoding. Packets received on an interface will be forwarded directly to neighboring interfaces without any form of validation. Use this option with caution.
